```{=html}
<iframe id="tukey-frame" src="../apps/tukey_table.html"
        style="width:100%; height:900px; border:0; display:block;"
        title="Tukey studentized range table (q-table)"></iframe>
<script>
window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {
  var frame = document.getElementById("tukey-frame");
  if (!frame || e.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
  if (e.data && e.data.type === "tukey-table-height") {
    frame.style.height = (e.data.height + 2) + "px";
  }
});
</script>
```
